tables.name: Bratislor Naming Method
tables.description: Five naming traditions for Bratislor: inherited geography (40%), family/landholder (25%), old service or trade site (15%), Carpathian-influenced border names (10%), and Haze-era folk renaming (10%). Each method remains a physically rollable pair of component tables.

results.name: Inherited Geographic Place Name
results.description: Historical landscape/settlement roots with inherited suffixes.

results.name: Family or Landholder Name
results.description: An old personal/family name with a settlement ending, not necessarily a celebrated founder.

results.name: Service or Occupation Name
results.description: Former settlement trade, craft, service or administrative function.

results.name: Carpathian Borderland Name
results.description: A smaller, loosely Romanian/Moldovan-influenced naming layer reflecting border communities.

results.name: Haze-Era Folk Name
results.description: Subdued landscape or hazard-related names, some arising after contamination or abandonment.
